def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def f3(g,bg,mark,fill,minmarks_border=2,minmarks_interior=3):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    mk=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mark]
    r0=min(i for i,j in mk); r1=max(i for i,j in mk)
    c0=min(j for i,j in mk); c1=max(j for i,j in mk)
    rowcnt=[sum(1 for i,j in mk if i==i_) for i_ in range(h)]
    colcnt=[sum(1 for i,j in mk if j==j_) for j_ in range(w)]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg: continue
            if not (r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1): continue
            if i in (r0,r1) and rowcnt[i]>=minmarks_border: o[i][j]=fill; continue
            if j in (c0,c1) and colcnt[j]>=minmarks_border: o[i][j]=fill; continue
            if rowcnt[i]>=minmarks_interior or colcnt[j]>=minmarks_interior: o[i][j]=fill
    return o

def analyze(name,gi,go,bg):
    R,C=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(R) if any(gi[r][c]!=bg for c in range(C))]
    cs=[c for c in range(C) if any(gi[r][c]!=bg for c in range(R))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[]
    for axis,lines in (('h',range(R)),('v',range(C))):
        for ln in lines:
            ps=(range(C) if axis=='h' else range(R))
            marks=[p for p in ps if gi[ln][p]!=bg]
            if len(marks)<2: continue
            isborder=(ln in (r0,r1)) if axis=='h' else (ln in (c0,c1))
            for a,b in zip(marks,marks[1:]):
                gap=b-a-1
                if gap==0: continue
                cells=[(ln,p) if axis=='h' else (p,ln) for p in range(a+1,b)]
                filled=all(go[r][c]==2 for r,c in cells)
                out.append(dict(demo=name,axis=axis,line=ln,nmarks=len(marks),border=isborder,
                                gap=gap,a=a,b=b,filled=filled))
    return out

def analyze2(name,gi,go,bg,mark):
    R,C=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(R) if any(gi[r][c]==mark for c in range(C))]
    cs=[c for c in range(C) if any(gi[r][c]==mark for r in range(R))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[]
    for axis,lines,ps in (('h',range(R),range(C)),('v',range(C),range(R))):
        for ln in lines:
            marks=[p for p in ps if (gi[ln][p]==mark if axis=='h' else gi[p][ln]==mark)]
            if len(marks)<2: continue
            isborder=(ln in (r0,r1)) if axis=='h' else (ln in (c0,c1))
            for a,b in zip(marks,marks[1:]):
                gap=b-a-1
                if gap==0: continue
                cells=[(ln,p) if axis=='h' else (p,ln) for p in range(a+1,b)]
                filled=all(go[r][c]==2 for r,c in cells)
                out.append(dict(demo=name,axis=axis,line=ln,nm=len(marks),bord=isborder,gap=gap,a=a,b=b,ok=filled))
    return out

lib='''def transform(grid):
    """task-5977762e: complete the lattice.
    bg = background; marks define lines. Paint bbox corners; fully complete
    (fill with fill color) every bbox-border line and every line with >=4 marks,
    between the bbox rails. Sparse interior lines (<=3 marks) untouched."""
    import collections
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals={v for row in grid for v in row}-{bg}
    mark=max(vals,key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    fill=2 if 2 in cnt or True else 2
    # fill color: the color appearing in output only; assume standard 2
    fill=2 if mark!=2 and bg!=2 else (3 if 3 not in (bg,mark) else 1)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rs=[r for r in range(R) if any(grid[r][c]==mark for c in range(C))]
    cs=[c for c in range(C) if any(grid[r][c]==mark for r in range(R))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    for r,c in {(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)}:
        if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    def comp_h(r,a,b):
        for c in range(a,b+1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    def comp_v(c,a,b):
        for r in range(a,b+1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    for ln in (r0,r1):
        m=[c for c in range(C) if grid[ln][c]==mark]
        if ln==r0 and grid[ln][c0]!=mark: m=[c0]+m
        if ln==r1 and grid[ln][c1]!=mark: m=m+[c1]
        m=sorted(set(m))
        if len(m)>=2: comp_h(ln,m[0],m[-1])
    for ln in (c0,c1):
        m=[r for r in range(R) if grid[r][ln]==mark]
        if ln==c0 and grid[r0][ln]!=mark: m=[r0]+m
        if ln==c1 and grid[r1][ln]!=mark: m=m+[r1]
        m=sorted(set(m))
        if len(m)>=2: comp_v(ln,m[0],m[-1])
    for r in range(R):
        if r in (r0,r1): continue
        m=[c for c in range(C) if grid[r][c]==mark]
        if len(m)>=4: comp_h(r,c0,c1)
    for c in range(C):
        if c in (c0,c1): continue
        m=[r for r in range(R) if grid[r][c]==mark]
        if len(m)>=4: comp_v(c,r0,r1)
    return out

def solve7(gi,bg,mk,fill=2):
    R,C=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    rs=[r for r in range(R) if any(gi[r][c]==mk for c in range(C))]
    cs=[c for c in range(C) if any(gi[r][c]==mk for r in range(R))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    hnm=[sum(1 for c in range(C) if gi[r][c]==mk) for r in range(R)]
    vnm=[sum(1 for r in range(R) if gi[r][c]==mk) for c in range(C)]
    # border rows/cols: fill gaps between consecutive anchors (marks + corners), paint corners
    corners={(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)}
    for (r,c) in corners:
        if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    def anchors(cells):  # positions along a border line, filled anchors count too
        return cells
    for r in (r0,r1):
        anc=[c for c in range(C) if gi[r][c]==mk or (r,c) in corners]
        for a,b in zip(anc,anc[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b):
                if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    for c in (c0,c1):
        anc=[r for r in range(R) if gi[r][c]==mk or (r,c) in corners]
        for a,b in zip(anc,anc[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b):
                if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    # interior: cell in gap of both lines, filled by dominant direction
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if out[r][c]!=bg: continue
            inrow = r in (r0,r1) or True
            # gaps of row r: between consecutive marks of row r
            rm=[x for x in range(C) if gi[r][x]==mk]
            cm=[x for x in range(R) if gi[x][c]==mk]
            ingap_r = len(rm)>=2 and rm[0]<c<rm[-1] and all(not(rm[i]<c<rm[i+1]) or True for i in range(len(rm)-1))
            ingap_r = any(a<c<b for a,b in zip(rm,rm[1:]))
            ingap_c = any(a<r<b for a,b in zip(cm,cm[1:]))
            if ingap_r and ingap_c:
                if hnm[r]>vnm[c]: out[r][c]=fill
                elif vnm[c]>hnm[r]: out[r][c]=fill
    return out

def bbox(gi,mk):
    R,C=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if gi[r][c]==mk]; cs=[c for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if gi[r][c]==mk]
    return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)

def feats(gi,go,bg,mk,r0,r1,c0,c1,r,c):
    row=[gi[r][x] for x in range(c0,c1+1)]; col=[gi[x][c] for x in range(r0,r1+1)]
    rr,cc=r-r0,c-c0
    def runs(seq,i):  # run length of marks ending just left of i, and starting just right of i
        L=0; j=i-1
        while j>=0 and seq[j]==mk: L+=1; j-=1
        Rt=0; j=i+1
        while j<len(seq) and seq[j]==mk: Rt+=1; j+=1
        return L,Rt
    # nearest marks in row/col (within bbox)
    li=max([x for x in range(c0,c) if gi[r][x]==mk],default=None)
    ri=min([x for x in range(c+1,c1+1) if gi[r][x]==mk],default=None)
    ui=max([x for x in range(r0,r) if gi[x][c]==mk],default=None)
    di=min([x for x in range(r+1,r1+1) if gi[x][c]==mk],default=None)
    hg=(c-li-1) if li is not None and ri is not None else None
    vg=(r-ui-1) if ui is not None and di is not None else None
    lL,lR=runs([gi[r][x] for x in range(len(gi[0]))],c)
    uL,uR=runs([gi[x][c] for x in range(len(gi))],r)
    hnm=sum(1 for x in range(c0,c1+1) if gi[r][x]==mk); vnm=sum(1 for x in range(r0,r1+1) if gi[x][c]==mk)
    hbg=(c1-c0+1)-hnm; vbg=(r1-r0+1)-vnm
    return dict(hg=hg,vg=vg,hnm=hnm,vnm=vnm,hbg=hbg,vbg=vbg,
                hl=lL,hr=lR,vu=uL,vd=uR,
                hspan=(ri-li) if li is not None and ri is not None else None,
                vspan=(di-ui) if ui is not None and di is not None else None,
                dt=r-r0,db=r1-r,dl=c-c0,dr=c1-c)
